rundown: JackJumpers beat Bullets 104-92. JackJumpers came back: they were down 52-50 at the half. The 3rd quarter decided it: JackJumpers won it 29-14.
Leading the way — JackJumpers: Kody Stattmann 28 pts; Will Magnay 5 ast; Josh Bannan 12 reb. Bullets: Nate Hinton 27 pts, 4 ast; Lat Mayen 8 reb.
Where JackJumpers won it: they shot 44% from three to 32%, won the boards 34-27 and had 22 assists to 13.

review.title: The algo's call
review.body:
Logged before the start, last snapshot Nov 15, 12:58 AM ET. It had JackJumpers 61% and Bullets 39%, projecting JackJumpers 92.9 – Bullets 89.5 (182.4 total, JackJumpers by 3.4).

Final: JackJumpers 104 – Bullets 92. Right winner: it had JackJumpers at 61%.

review.title: How the ratings held up
review.body:
JackJumpers came in with a 3% below average attack and a 2% stingier than average defense (8-4, 93.9 scored and 90.3 allowed a game over 12 games), worth about 8 and 8 games of evidence. Projected to score 92.9, they scored 104 (+11.1 points, 12% over); projected to allow 89.5, they allowed 92 (+2.5 points, 3% over).

Bullets came in with a 5% below average attack and a league-average defense (6-7, 94.5 scored and 98.8 allowed a game over 13 games), worth about 8 and 8 games of evidence. Projected to score 89.5, they scored 92 (+2.5 points, 3% over); projected to allow 92.9, they allowed 104 (+11.1 points, 12% over).

The bigger miss was JackJumpers' scoring (+11.1 points against projection); both sides outscored their projections, so the game ran hotter than either team's numbers said.

review.title: Where the result sat in the simulations
review.body:
Total: 196 against 182.4 projected (+13.6), about the 80th percentile of the simulated totals (a typical game swings ±16).

Margin: JackJumpers by 12 against JackJumpers by 3.4 projected, about the 24th percentile of the simulated margins (typical swing ±12).

An ordinary result: inside the range the simulations expected most of the time.

review.title: Situational factors, checked
review.body: Nothing situational moved this projection (rest, travel, form and conditions were all normal), so it came down to team strength.

review.title: Against the market
review.body: No line was priced for this game (no posted odds, or not enough data to price one).

review.title: What could have made it wrong
review.body:
Flagged going in: there were no odds to check the projection against.

The projection landed within its normal range anyway, so the flags didn't cost it much this time.

review.title: What the algo learns
review.body:
This game's own lesson: scoring came in at ×1.080 of the raw projection, and the home side beat its projected margin by -9.7 points. It counts toward Hoops+ scoring level, home edge and both teams' attack and defense corrections.

Across 57 graded Hoops+ games the algo now scales scoring ×1.008 and gives home teams -1.1 points. Team corrections so far: Bullets attack ×1.003, defense ×1.018 (3 games).

review.title: Bottom line
review.body: Right side, total within its normal range, margin within its normal range, no bet.
